answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Entry needs a vouching bond — an established identity stakes 78 POA behind each newcomer and loses it on conviction. A sybil operator must buy sponsors for every fake, turning each alias into a 78-POA liability instead of a free account. A bought sponsor costs more than the fake's first epoch of emission. The wander of the design is public, the saffron of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the canyon of honest work is what finally pays. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
